fee_notes: Royalty is 6% of Net Sales for most stores. Co-Branded Other Locations: 7% Auntie Anne's + 6% Jamba (each may increase to 8%/7%). Co-Branded Streetside: 6% (may increase to 7%). Ad contribution 3% of Net Sales (Co-Branded Other: 2% AA + 3% Jamba). Local Marketing Obligation: 1% of Net Sales quarterly. Total Ad Contribution + Local Marketing capped at 5% of Net Sales.
